meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 执行 Bash 命令时，输出会被 rtk 代理压缩，token 消耗可节省 60–90%，命令照常运行。
howto.when: 当 Claude 调用 Bash 工具执行任何命令时触发，包括 git、pytest、docker、kubectl 等常用开发命令。

say.text: 运行 git status 看看仓库状态
say.note: 命令输出会被 rtk 压缩，节省 token。

say.text: 执行 pytest 跑一下测试
say.note: 同样经过 rtk 代理，输出精简。

say.text: 用 docker ps 列出容器
say.note: rtk 会拦截并压缩结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, when Claude runs a Bash command, the output is routed through rtk, which compresses it, cutting token usage by 60–90% while the command runs normally.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever Claude invokes the Bash tool to run any command, including git, pytest, docker, kubectl, and other common dev commands.

say_en.text: Run git status to see the repo state
say_en.note: Output is compressed by rtk, saving tokens.

say_en.text: Execute pytest to run the tests
say_en.note: Also proxied via rtk, output minimized.

say_en.text: Use docker ps to list containers
say_en.note: rtk intercepts and compresses the result.
